# Uzbekistan FIFA World Cup 2026 preview: Cannavaro’s White Wolves aim to make a splash
[...]
Uzbekistan has already created history by qualifying for the World Cup for the first time ever. The side excelled in the second and third rounds of AFC qualifying, losing just a solitary game, to book its tickets to the World Cup.
[...]
Despite Timur Kapadze leading the team into its maiden World Cup, the White Wolves have opted to go a different route to wade through the pressure of the tournament, appointing Fabio Cannavaro as the head coach in 2025. The 2006 World Cup-winning captain will hope he can transfer his experience of the big stage onto the youthful Uzbek group who will have no fear of failure.

Uzbekistan deploys a three-man central defence and is a team built on solidity and physical presence. The player and the manager pride themselves on being difficult to break down and the Central Asian nation will look to be thorn in the side of the bigger teams in the group.
[...]
Player to watch out for
[...]
Abdukodir Khusanov: The 22-year-old defender has had a breakout year in Manchester City blue, deputising admirably well for the injured Ruben Dias. He has already accumulated 25 caps for his nation and will look to be a leader on the pitch in its first World Cup appearance.
[...]
Not many managers at this World Cup can boast about being Ballon d’Or winners. In fact Cannavaro is the only one who can stake a claim. The Italian legend started his coaching career in the top Asian leagues and took over Uzbekistan after a brief 14-game stay at Dinamo Zagreb of Croatia where it beat his old nemesis AC Milan in the group stage.

results.title: Iraq to Win World Cup Odds: Predictions & Best Bets 2026
highlights:
At 1500/1 to win the tournament outright, Iraq sit 43rd in the outright winner market out of 48 teams. That price reflects reality: this is a group-stage underdog, not a genuine contender to lift the trophy.
[...]
That said, Iraq World Cup 2026 odds offer some genuine value in alternative markets, and their story alone makes them one of the most compelling sides to follow across the tournament. This article covers their odds, predictions, best bets and everything you need to know ahead of their group fixtures.
[...]
- Best Pick: Iraq to be eliminated in the group stage
- Confidence: 4/5
- Best Odds: Available at leading operators
- Reason: Placed in Group I alongside France, Norway and Senegal, Iraq face three opponents who are all significantly stronger on paper, making a group-stage exit the most realistic and value-representative outcome.
[...]
Realistically, progressing beyond the group stage would be a significant achievement. Should Iraq advance, a Round of 32 tie would pit them against a side from another group, likely another strong European or South American nation. The stage-of-elimination market, specifically a first-round exit, appears to offer the most grounded betting angle. The outright winner price of 1500/1 reflects just how distant a deep run genuinely is.
[...]
- Group I Winner (109/1): Iraq to finish top of Group I. France are heavy favourites in this market, making this another long-odds option for Iraq.
[...]
With France, Norway and Senegal all in Group I, Iraq face three opponents who are considerably stronger in terms of FIFA ranking and tournament pedigree. Iraq’s qualifying record of four wins, three draws and two losses, with a goal difference of just +1, shows a side built on margins rather than dominance. A group-stage exit is the most logical outcome and the most defensible betting position.

results.title: Uzbekistan to Win World Cup Odds and 2026 Predictions
highlights:
Uzbekistan are making their World Cup debut at the 2026 tournament, and their outright odds reflect exactly that status. Priced at 2000/1 with the best available price sitting at 1500/1, they rank 43rd of 48 teams in the outright winner market.
[...]
For bettors interested in Uzbekistan world cup betting, the more realistic conversation centres on group-stage survival and the stage-of-elimination markets rather than lifting the trophy in July. This article covers Uzbekistan World Cup 2026 odds across every relevant market, a squad breakdown under Fabio Cannavaro, their route through Group K, and the best bets available.
[...]
- Best Pick: Uzbekistan To Qualify From Group K
- Confidence: 2/5
- Best Odds: 37/1 (Group K Winner)
- Reason: A debut side facing Portugal and Colombia, with DR Congo as the realistic fourth-place rival, makes group progression a long shot but not impossible for a team that went unbeaten in the final stretch of AFC qualifying.
[...]
Uzbekistan are in Group K alongside Portugal, Colombia, and DR Congo. Their schedule opens on 17 June 2026 against Colombia in Mexico City, followed by a fixture against Portugal in Houston on 23 June, and a final group game against DR Congo in Atlanta on 27 June.
[...]
Realistically, Portugal and Colombia are both likely to advance from the group. That makes the Uzbekistan versus DR Congo match on 27 June the defining fixture for any chance of progression. If Uzbekistan can take points from Colombia and avoid defeat against DR Congo, a third-place finish with enough points to advance as one of the best third-placed sides is not entirely out of the question given the expanded 48-team format.
[...]
Should they somehow progress beyond the group stage, a Round of 32 meeting with a top seed from another group would almost certainly end their run. For Uzbekistan World Cup 2026 predictions, the stage-of-elimination market centred on group-stage exit offers more realistic value than any outright or deep-run bet.
[...]
- To Win Group K (37/1): Portugal and Colombia are heavy favourites to top the group. Uzbekistan winning it would require a major upset across multiple fixtures.
[...]
If you want to back a realistic outcome, a group-stage exit is where the probability lies for a side making their World Cup debut against Portugal and Colombia. This market should be available at tight odds and represents a straightforward reflection of where Uzbekistan World Cup 2026 tips and analysis point.
